files.text:
CMOS static set-reset latch
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VR r 0 PWL(0 3.3 10n 3.3 10.1n 0 100n 0 100.1n 3.3 110n 3.3 110.1n 0 210n 0)
VS s 0 PWL(0 0 30n 0 30.1n 3.3 40n 3.3 40.1n 0 170n 0 170.1n 3.3 180n 3.3 180.1n 0 210n 0)
XDUT vdd 0 s r out astra_038_cmos_static_sr_latch
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec initial range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec set_q range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec hold_q range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec reset_q range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec hold_reset range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec set_again range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 210n
meas tran initial FIND v(out) AT=20n
meas tran set_q FIND v(out) AT=50n
meas tran hold_q FIND v(out) AT=80n
meas tran reset_q FIND v(out) AT=120n
meas tran hold_reset FIND v(out) AT=150n
meas tran set_again FIND v(out) AT=190n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
